calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: See your hearings in your phone calendar, and bring in your old diary without retyping.
calendar.offlineReason: Settings can be changed when you are back online.

error.title: Could not load the calendar settings.

feed.title: Calendar feed
feed.description: A private link your calendar app subscribes to. It shows confirmed hearings and deadlines only.
feed.empty: No feed yet. Create one to see hearings in your phone calendar.
feed.maskedUrl: The link is shown once, when you create or rotate it.
feed.privacy: Anyone with this link can see your hearing dates. Keep it private.
feed.shownOnce: Copy it now. It will not be shown again.
feed.offline: Settings can be changed when you are back online.

scope.label: Which matters
scope.ownerOnly: Only workspace owners can share the whole workspace.

parties.label: Include party names
parties.why: Calendar providers fetch this feed on servers outside India. Party names stay out unless you turn this on.

disclosure.text: Your calendar app may fetch this feed from servers outside India. We keep the content minimal.

feed.rotateBody: The current link stops working at once. Update the subscription in your calendar app with the new link.
feed.revokeBody: The link stops working at once and your calendar app stops updating. You can create a new feed later.

toast.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it.

import.title: Import a calendar file
import.description: Bring in diary entries without retyping. Hearing-like events become proposals that you confirm one by one.
import.instructions: Export your calendar as an .ics file (Google, Outlook and Apple all can), then choose it here. Importing the same calendar again only picks up what changed.
import.duplicate: You already imported this exact file.
import.channelOff: Calendar files are switched off for this workspace. An owner can turn them on in the inbox settings.
import.tooLarge: That file is too large. Calendar files can be up to 1 MB.
import.invalid: That does not look like a calendar file.
import.failed: The file could not be sent. Try again.

review.title: Calendar import
review.ignored: {count} other events were not hearings and were skipped.
review.processing: Reading your calendar file. This page updates when it is ready.
review.failed: This calendar file could not be read.
review.empty: No hearing-like events were found in this file.

preview.conflict: Differs from the confirmed next date. Confirming makes {date} the next date; you can undo it.
preview.listing_update: Updates the item number of the confirmed listing.
preview.unmatched: No single matter has this case number.

review.attach: Attach to a matter as a note
review.attachHint: A note has no date. It does not change any hearing date or create a matter.
